'''Enos Ozzel''' was a scion of the [[Ozzel family/Legends|Ozzel family]], and an ancestor to [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was reputed to have pushed the [[Cold Coil]] back into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] during the early [[Manderon Period]].<ref name="IH" />
